description: Apply a styled business stamp (like a rubber stamp) to PDF pages. Pre-configured styles for common stamps, or create custom ones. Draws a bordered rectangle with text inside, slightly rotated for authenticity.

customText.description: Custom stamp text (only used when type is CUSTOM)

pages.description: Pages to stamp (1-indexed). Omit for all.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees for rubber-stamp look (default: -15)

type.description: Stamp type. Use CUSTOM with customText for your own stamp.

name: pdf_stamp
